text:
maria-sales: Quick heads-up, ACME POC can't hit /v1/generate on the demo environment, getting 403s. Call in 20. Can someone triage?

acme_poc: here's the minimal repro (key redacted):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer rwd_trial_ABC123\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-mini\",\"input\":\"hi\"}'
```
Response:
{"error":"permission_denied","message":"token missing project claim: acme-demo","code":403}

tom-eng: error means token doesn't include the project claim for acme-demo. Trial keys sometimes require explicit org/project binding when account has multiple projects.

acme_poc: we didn't set any X-Redwood headers. Is that required?

liz-support: not always, but try adding headers to bind the request: `-H \"X-Redwood-Org: acme-org\" -H \"X-Redwood-Project: acme-demo\"`. If that fails I'll mint a short-lived project-scoped key with generate:write.

infra-bot: policy-evaluator: request blocked  reason=missing_project_claim; expected=project:acme-demo

acme_poc: added headers and still 403.

liz-support: creating temp key now (TTL 2h) with scopes: ["generate:write","embeddings:read"]. DMing to the contact.

acme_poc: temp key works, generates succeed. Thanks. Quick follow-up: we saw a 429 during a load run. Any tips?

tom-eng: 429s are rate-limit or concurrency caps; demo keys have low burst limits. For production we recommend reserved capacity or a higher quota test key. We can also suggest exponential backoff and limited parallel streams in the client.

maria-sales: noted. I'll include a pricing note for reserved capacity in the follow-up email and ask for a 24h extended key if they want to stress test.

liz-support: I'll also add a console alert to surface spikes of "missing_project_claim" so support sees this faster.

acme_poc: re-testing on the call now  looks good. Appreciate the rapid help.

maria-sales: great, closing loop. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
